Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: Zwitterionic Engineering of Vinylene-Linked Covalent Organic Frameworks for Superior Protonic Electrolytes
Paper_Metadata.Note: DOI not found in OCR text; journal identified as Angewandte Chemie based on supporting file name pattern (anie71731-sup-0001-SuppMat.docx)

Composition.Monomer_or_Formula: Zwitterionic vinylene-linked COF synthesized from TFPT + SPTMP via Knoevenagel condensation
Functional_Groups: Sulfobetaine zwitterionic moieties (sulfopropyl pendant chains with quaternary ammonium + sulfonate)
Composition.Note: Zwitterionic COF with coexisting positively charged quaternary ammonium and negatively charged sulfonate groups

Process_Text.original: Synthesized through a Knoevenagel condensation reaction between TFPT and SPTMP
Process_Text.simplified: Knoevenagel condensation of TFPT and SPTMP

Structure_Text.original: Both COFs exhibit high crystallinity. Pawley refinement indicates that both structures adopt an eclipsed AA stacking model. Characteristic diffraction peaks were observed at approximately 5.6°, 9.8°, 11.4°, 15.0°, and 26.0°, corresponding to the (100), (110), (200), (210), and (001) crystal planes, sequentially. FT-IR: C=C stretching at 965 cm⁻¹, S=O stretching at 1037 cm⁻¹, disappearance of C=O at 1700 cm⁻¹. ¹³C CP-MAS NMR: 170, 152, 145, 140, 119, 49, 15 ppm. BET surface area 502 m² g⁻¹, pore volume 0.29 cm³ g⁻¹, pore diameter 1.3 nm. XPS: distinct S 2p characteristic signals.
Structure_Text.simplified: Crystalline vinylene-linked COF with AA eclipsed stacking, microporous (1.3 nm pores), BET 502 m² g⁻¹

Porosity.Note: Pore diameter estimated; text states 'pore diameters'; diameter/radius not explicitly clarified

NMR_13C_CP_MAS.Assignment: Pyridinyl ring carbon and vinylene carbon
Alkane carbon of sulfopropyl chains (ZVCOF only)
Alkane carbon of sulfopropyl chains (ZVCOF only)

XPS.Note: Confirms successful incorporation of sulfobetaine groups; NVCOF shows no sulfur signal

Chemical_Stability.Note: Retained crystallinity after immersion in 12 M HCl or 12 M NaOH for 48 h (Figure S8)

Properties.Note: Pristine ZVCOF poor conductivity due to insufficient proton sources; range reported for pristine COFs collectively

Structure_Text.original: Both COFs exhibit high crystallinity with AA eclipsed stacking. Same characteristic diffraction peaks. FT-IR: C=C stretching at 965 cm⁻¹, disappearance of C=O at 1700 cm⁻¹ (no S=O band). 13C CP-MAS NMR: 170, 152, 145, 140, 119 ppm (no 49 or 15 ppm signals). BET surface area 937 m² g⁻¹, pore volume 0.32 cm³ g⁻¹, pore diameter 1.7 nm. No sulfur signal in XPS.
